title: Release audit: The sensitive-action guard is incomplete for required explicit actions. `SENSITI
summary: Extend sensitive-action detection with verb-plus-object handling for English and Russian, including the missing key, config, and scaffold terms, and add tests that these requests are refused and produce no outgoing engine `say` request while ordinary mentions remain forwarded.
requirements: The sensitive-action guard is incomplete for required explicit actions. `SENSITIVE_MARKERS`, `CREDENTIAL_NOUNS`, `CONFIG_NOUNS` and the create/change stems do not cover bare `key`/`ключ`, `config`, or `scaffold`, so free-text requests such as `change config`, `create a key`, `создай ключ`, or `scaffold a project` are not refused and can be sent to the engine as ordinary `say` requests. This violates the requirement that setting key material and changing configuration or creating/scaffolding a project never happen from free text alone. No tests assert no-passthrough for these forms.
